card.title: Impossible Currency
card.instruction: Price every favor in symbolic acts, imaginary resources, or promises that cannot be measured normally.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Borrow my ladder for one shadow until Friday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need my shadow at work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep its office hours. I'll take its evenings.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you hold the ladder too? I'm afraid of heights.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For that, leave me your fear of falling. I'll keep it until you're down; you can climb without it.

mechanism: A prices practical help in a shadow and a transferable fear, renegotiating the impossible currency around B's needs.
confusable: Unlike ordinary barter, the price must consist of symbolic or unmeasurable resources.
comparison: The ladder exchange trades useful emotional relief as payment; the kettle scene ages time into the requested currency.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
